source.title: Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 4 ("Notice of Result of Elections - Newry No. 1 Rural Council")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: Returning Officer's notice of result, column 6 (candidates elected) with no votes in column 5 (no poll), read on the page image (Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 4)

note: Triennial election of the 14 electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Hilltown was the only division contested; no nomination was received for Glen, whose retiring member was deemed to be re-elected. Returned unopposed.
